official_sources.title: GDAL Geotransform Tutorial — pixel/line to georeferenced coordinates
official_sources.finding: A geotransform maps pixel/line coordinates to georeferenced coordinates with six coefficients; pixel centers are offset by 0.5 from pixel corners.
official_sources.limitation: Exact parcel extrema require a declared center/edge convention and verified geotransform; metadata alone does not prove parcel-mask correctness.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official project documentation page; site/project licence terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL Raster Data Model — scale, offset, units and statistics
official_sources.finding: Raster bands may carry scale, offset, unit, NoData/mask and statistics metadata; statistics can be approximate.
official_sources.limitation: Stored min/max metadata must not replace full-value decoding when exact extrema are required.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official project documentation page; site/project licence terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL RFC 15 — raster validity masks
official_sources.finding: GDAL formalizes validity masks with zero indicating invalid pixels and non-zero indicating valid pixels, alongside NoData and alpha-mask mechanisms.
official_sources.limitation: Mask interpretation must be bound to the exact band and dataset; losing a sidecar mask can change validity semantics.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official project documentation page; site/project licence terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL raster reproject — NoData and interpolation behavior
official_sources.finding: Reprojection treats invalid source pixels according to NoData/mask rules, and interpolation kernels differ in how invalid contributors are handled.
official_sources.limitation: Reprojected pixels are derived values and should not be treated as native source extrema without an explicit resampling policy.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official project documentation page; site/project licence terms apply

official_sources.title: gdalwarp — source overviews and resampling caveat
official_sources.finding: Downsampling can use existing source overviews by default, whose creation resampling may differ from the requested warp resampling; overview use can be disabled.
official_sources.limitation: Exact extrema can be altered by overview/downsample paths, so native full-resolution reads must be enforced for terminal results.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official project documentation page; site/project licence terms apply

official_sources.title: GDALRasterBand exact min/max and location API
official_sources.finding: Exact min/max can be computed by reading all pixels when approximation is disabled; NoData and masked pixels are excluded. Multiple equal extrema do not specify which location is returned.
official_sources.limitation: A deterministic parcel result needs an explicit tie policy because the API does not define which equal-extrema location is returned.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official project documentation page; site/project licence terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL raster calc — aligned raster algebra and pixel-center variables
official_sources.finding: Raster algebra checks spatial reference and extent by default, and exposes pixel-center coordinates; multiple inputs may have different resolution.
official_sources.limitation: Disabling extent checks or silently mixing grids can invalidate a parcel mask or error-budget calculation.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official project documentation page; site/project licence terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL raster footprint — valid-data footprint from masks/NoData
official_sources.finding: Raster footprints can be derived from valid pixels using intrinsic mask bands or explicit NoData values.
official_sources.limitation: A coverage footprint is not a parcel mask; both must be intersected and audited separately.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official project documentation page; site/project licence terms apply

official_sources.title: PROJ cs2cs — only-best, no-ballpark and accuracy controls
official_sources.finding: PROJ can require the best known transformation, reject ballpark operations, and constrain candidate operations by desired accuracy.
official_sources.limitation: Strict options still require the correct source/target CRS and area of interest; they do not validate source coordinates.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official project documentation page; site/project licence terms apply

official_sources.title: PROJ projinfo — grid availability and area-aware operation discovery
official_sources.finding: projinfo can evaluate operation candidates with area/bbox constraints and policies for missing transformation grids.
official_sources.limitation: A transformation should fail closed when a required grid is unavailable or the target is outside the operation's intended area.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official project documentation page; site/project licence terms apply

official_sources.title: PROJ Glossary — ballpark transformation risk
official_sources.finding: A ballpark transformation may omit datum shifts; its accuracy is unknown and vertical ballpark errors can reach tens of metres.
official_sources.limitation: Ballpark operations are unacceptable for parcel-scale elevation differences.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official project documentation page; site/project licence terms apply

official_sources.title: PROJ coordinate-operation computation and grid instantiability
official_sources.finding: PROJ ranks candidate operations using grid availability, known accuracy and area of use; missing grids can make otherwise preferred operations unusable.
official_sources.limitation: The selected operation, required grids, PROJ database/version and area-of-use decision must be recorded for reproducibility.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official project documentation page; site/project licence terms apply
